name: Hunyuan3D 2 Multiview
description: Tencent's Hunyuan3D-2mv pipeline. Accepts multiple reference images (front, back, left, right) per generation for higher-fidelity mesh reconstruction than the single-image mini model.
author: community-fork (based on lightningpixel/modly-hunyuan3d-mini-turbo-extension)

params_schema.label: Quality
params_schema.tooltip: Number of diffusion steps. More steps = better quality but slower.

params_schema.label: Mesh Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Octree resolution for mesh reconstruction. Higher = more detail but slower and more VRAM.

params_schema.label: Guidance Scale
params_schema.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance strength. Higher = closer to the input images.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Seed for reproducibility. Set to -1 for a random seed.
